rationale: The agent verified the user by full name plus prior ZIP, which matched a single profile via the tool. It correctly declined to update the address without the full new address and did not perform any writes without explicit confirmation. When asked about ordering products, the agent required a shipping address and payment method before proceeding, which aligns with policy. It used product-detail tools to provide pricing/options and did not place an order without the necessary info. No evidence shows it acted on another account or fabricated unsupported facts (tool outputs were truncated but consistent with the responses). While the original address update wasn’t completed due to the user withholding info, the agent’s behavior adhered to policy throughout.
